title: Reborn Shut In Discovers Secret Magic — Part 1

series.summary: After dying in a traffic accident, a former shut-in reincarnates into a fantasy world as baby Rudeus Greyrat and secretly teaches himself chantless water magic from a grimoire.

series_summary: After dying in a traffic accident, a former shut-in reincarnates into a fantasy world as baby Rudeus Greyrat and secretly teaches himself chantless water magic from a grimoire.

cuts.voiceover_text: A fatal crash in the rain ends his wasted life, but death is not the finish. He sacrifices himself to shove strangers away from a speeding truck.
cuts.raw_narration: A fatal crash in the rain ends his wasted life, but death is not the finish. He sacrifices himself to shove strangers away from a speeding truck.

cuts.voiceover_text: He opens his eyes inside a strange cottage. A joyous couple cradles him. He has reincarnated as a newborn baby named Rudeus.
cuts.raw_narration: He opens his eyes inside a strange cottage. A joyous couple cradles him. He has reincarnated as a newborn baby named Rudeus.

cuts.voiceover_text: As a toddler, Rudeus secretly opens an ancient grimoire. He focuses his mind, feeling mystical mana stir within his small hands.
cuts.raw_narration: As a toddler, Rudeus secretly opens an ancient grimoire. He focuses his mind, feeling mystical mana stir within his small hands.

cuts.voiceover_text: Without uttering a single incantation, he forms a floating water sphere. But as the magic surges, can he keep this impossible talent hidden from his family?
